title: A Small Garden of Time
paragraphs: Begin with a pot you can lift and a patch of light you can visit. A modest garden asks for observation before it asks for equipment.
Touch the soil each morning. Record when it feels dry, where the shade falls, and which leaves turn toward the window. A notebook makes changes visible without turning them into a competition.
Leave one square blank on every page. Something unexpected will grow there: a question, a new shoot, or a reason to begin again.
